text: Lithium-ion batteries or products containing them (power banks, cordless devices) listed without a UN38.3 test summary must be held. The vendor is required to supply the UN38.3 test summary before the listing can proceed.
action: Request UN38.3 test summary from vendor; hold listing until received.

text: Cosmetic and personal-care products offered without a product safety data sheet (PSDS) or ingredient/INCI list cannot be classified. Missing composition documentation blocks compliance review.
action: Request INCI/ingredient list and safety data sheet from vendor.

text: Products on the controlled-substances precursor list (e.g. certain chemicals convertible to regulated compounds) are prohibited from general marketplace sale in the EU without a special authorization on file.
action: Block listing; escalate to Regulatory team for authorization check.

text: Weapons, weapon replicas, and realistic imitation firearms are restricted across DE, PL and SE marketplaces and may not be listed under general categories.
action: Block listing; route to Restricted Products specialist.

text: Food, supplements and ingestible products must carry allergen labeling and net-quantity declarations in the destination-market language. Listings missing mandatory allergen statements are non-compliant.
action: Request compliant localized label artwork from vendor.

text: Electrical products sold in the EU must display CE marking and, where applicable, the responsible economic operator's address. Absent CE marking on the product or packaging renders the listing non-compliant.
action: Request CE marking evidence and economic-operator details from vendor.

text: Products listed under an incorrect product-type or HS/commodity code that changes the applicable regulatory regime must be reclassified before launch. A category mismatch that alters safety obligations is a blocking defect.
action: Reassign correct product type/commodity code; re-run compliance checks.

text: Medical devices mislabeled as general consumer goods must be reclassified. A device making a therapeutic or diagnostic claim falls under medical-device regulation regardless of the listed category.
action: Reclassify as medical device; route for conformity assessment.

text: Products requiring an age gate (e.g. bladed tools, certain solvents, alcohol) must have age-verification controls applied at listing. Age-restricted goods listed without the control are non-compliant.
Health, medical or disease-treatment claims on non-medical products (e.g. supplements claiming to cure illness) are prohibited marketing claims and must be removed before the listing can proceed.
action: Request removal of prohibited health claims from listing content.

text: Environmental claims such as 'biodegradable' or 'eco-friendly' without substantiating certification constitute unsubstantiated green claims and are not permitted.
action: Request substantiating certification or removal of the environmental claim.

text: Listings with a missing or implausible net weight, dimension, or unit-of-measure that breaks downstream reporting must be corrected. Values of zero or impossible magnitudes are data-quality defects.
action: Request corrected weight/dimension/UoM values from vendor.

text: Duplicate listings sharing the same GTIN/EAN but differing core attributes create reconciliation conflicts and must be merged or corrected before reporting.
Products missing a valid country-of-origin value, or declaring an embargoed/sanctioned origin, cannot be cleared. Country of origin is mandatory for customs and regulatory reporting.
action: Request valid country-of-origin declaration from vendor.

text: Dangerous goods (aerosols, flammables, corrosives) listed without a correct ADR/transport hazard classification must be held. Hazard class and UN number are required for compliant shipping.
action: Request ADR hazard classification and UN number from vendor.

text: Listings using a protected brand name, logo or trademarked term without authorization are potential intellectual-property infringements and must be withheld pending brand verification.
action: Withhold listing; route to Brand Protection for authorization check.

text: Listing titles, images or descriptions containing offensive, hateful or adult content not permitted in the destination marketplace must be rejected.
action: Reject listing content; request compliant replacement.

text: Energy-related products sold in the EU (e.g. lamps, displays, appliances) must display the correct EU energy-efficiency label and class. Missing or outdated energy labels are non-compliant.
action: Request current EU energy-efficiency label from vendor.
